title: Sony Centre Fury are 2024 Senior Men Playoff Champions!
description: Sony Centre Fury are 2024 Senior Men Playoff Champions in Scotland! They edged St Mirren 93-64 in the Final game. After a tough 18-17 start, Sony Centre Fury took full control of the game. They erupted with a massive run to take a 50-25 halftime advantage. Fury led 71-45 after three quarters and easily clinched the win at the end.
imageCaption: Sony Centre Fury are 2024 Senior Men Playoff Champions!
